prompt: Bright sunshine is on the way, so picnic blankets (can / to spread) on the dry grass.
explanation_ru: После модального глагола can в пассивном залоге ставится be + третья форма глагола spread (spread): can be spread.

prompt: We are delighted because twenty new wooden benches (will / to place) along our quiet park path.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после will требуются глагол be и третья форма глагола place (placed): will be placed.

prompt: Every new account form (have to / to sign) by the customer before the card arrives.
explanation_ru: Подлежащее form стоит в единственном числе, поэтому конструкция have to принимает форму has to, а далее идёт be + V3: has to be signed.

prompt: Lost bags at the train station ___ without a valid ticket or photo ID.
explanation_ru: После модального глагола cannot в пассивном залоге ставится be + третья форма глагола (V3) без частицы to: cannot be collected.

prompt: According to the wall sign, wet umbrellas (must / not / to bring) inside the main hall.
explanation_ru: Запрет в пассивном залоге строится по схеме must not + be + V3 (третья форма bring — brought): must not be brought.

prompt: My old phone is slow, so the system software ___ before I download new apps.
explanation_ru: После модальной конструкции ought to в пассиве обязательны be и третья форма глагола (V3): ought to be updated.

prompt: During the job interview, you (might / to ask) about your previous office experience.
explanation_ru: Для выражения вероятности в пассивном залоге после might используется be + V3: might be asked.

prompt: Our school team played brilliantly, so our next basketball match (will / to show) on local TV.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после will ставится be и третья форма неправильного глагола show (shown): will be shown.

prompt: I dropped too much salt into the pan, so this soup (cannot / to eat) tonight.
explanation_ru: После cannot в пассиве ставится be и третья форма глагола eat (eaten): cannot be eaten.

prompt: If we miss the evening express train, our return tickets ___ on the morning bus.
explanation_ru: В английском языке два модальных глагола (will и can) не ставятся рядом; для возможности используется can + be + V3: can be used.

prompt: Before the moving van arrives, all your glass plates (should / to pack) in thick paper.
explanation_ru: Совет в пассивном залоге строится по модели should + be + V3: should be packed.

prompt: Strange links from unknown email addresses (should / not / to open) on a work computer.
explanation_ru: Отрицание в пассиве после should строится как should not + be + V3: should not be opened.

prompt: We bought our theatre tickets online, so paper copies (have to / not / to print).

blanks.answer: do not have to be printed
accepted_answers: do not have to be printed

explanation_ru: Отсутствие необходимости для множественного числа (copies) выражается через do not have to + be + V3: do not have to be printed.

prompt: Passengers are welcome to bring a small backpack, which (can / to keep) under the seat.
explanation_ru: После модального глагола can в пассиве ставятся be и третья форма глагола keep (kept): can be kept.

prompt: Without a signed parent note tomorrow, you (will / not / to allow) on the school bus.
explanation_ru: Отрицание в пассивном залоге с will строится по схеме will not + be + V3: will not be allowed.

prompt: All international boxes must to be weighed at the post office desk before shipping.
answer: All international boxes must be weighed at the post office desk before shipping.

prompt: During busy holiday sales, online clothes orders (might / to deliver) one or two days late.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после might требуется связка be и третья форма глагола (V3): might be delivered.

prompt: Free study rooms on the top floor will can be booked through the student website.
answer: Free study rooms on the top floor can be booked through the student website.
accepted_answers: Free study rooms on the top floor can be booked through the student website.
Free study rooms on the top floor will be booked through the student website.

prompt: Strong pain tablets ___ at this local pharmacy without a signed note from a doctor.
explanation_ru: После cannot в пассиве нужны глагол be и третья форма глагола sell (sold): cannot be sold.

prompt: Rain is coming tonight, so our young apple trees (have to / not / to water) today.

blanks.answer: do not have to be watered
accepted_answers: do not have to be watered

explanation_ru: Для множественного числа (trees) отсутствие необходимости в пассиве передаётся через do not have to + be + V3: do not have to be watered.

prompt: When you enter the sports club, your member card (must / to show) at the desk.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после must ставятся be и третья форма глагола show (shown): must be shown.

prompt: Hi Julia, Henry says his broken bike ___ by his uncle before the weekend ride.
explanation_ru: После модального глагола could в пассивном залоге ставится be + третья форма глагола (V3): could be fixed.

prompt: Victor's big chocolate cake (ought to / to keep) in the cool fridge until the guests arrive.
explanation_ru: После ought to в пассивном залоге ставится be и третья форма глагола keep (kept): ought to be kept.

prompt: Friday evening is always busy here, so corner tables ___ at least two days ahead.
explanation_ru: В пассиве после should частица to не ставится; правильная форма — should be booked.

prompt: Heavy rain is coming, so the evening park concert (could / to move) into the town hall.
explanation_ru: Для выражения возможности в пассиве после could используется be + V3: could be moved.

prompt: Workers finished early, so the wide main street (will / to open) to cars again tomorrow.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после will ставится be и третья форма глагола open (opened): will be opened.

prompt: Winter coats and sweaters (can / to exchange) within two weeks if the paper tag stays on.
explanation_ru: После модального глагола can в пассиве требуется связка be и третья форма глагола (V3): can be exchanged.
